office_does: The coroner runs death investigations in Kittitas County, certifies cause and manner of death and keeps the related public records, working with families, law enforcement and medical partners.
race_blurb: Coroner Cori McKean, the long-time chief deputy appointed after Coroner Nick Henderson's 2025 death, runs to keep the office's direction and build a county morgue. Deputy Coroner Charlie Divine runs on modernizing investigations and restoring accountability and team culture. An outside investigation this year cleared McKean of a staff complaint. Both the short and the full term are on the ballot; McKean led the primary 65% to 35%.

candidates.summary: Appointed Kittitas County Coroner and former chief deputy coroner, running to keep the office's direction and add a county morgue.
highlights: In the Coroner's Office since 2019; chief deputy who led its 2024 accreditation [S2][S4]
Appointed coroner in November 2025 after Nick Henderson's death [S5][S6]
An outside investigation of a 2026 staff complaint found her decisions within her authority [S7][S8]
Proposes the county's first dedicated morgue, citing a feasibility study [S3]

experience.basis: Sitting coroner and long-time chief deputy who led the office's accreditation, running to be retained.

spending.basis: Proposes a new, purpose-built county morgue facility, while framing it as a cost-conscious rural solution.

reform.basis: Campaign to 'retain' her centers on continuing the office's accreditation, training and partnerships.

candidates.summary: Kittitas County deputy coroner since 2022 and former anesthesia technician, running on modernizing investigations and restoring confidence in the office.
highlights: Deputy coroner since 2022, hired by Nick Henderson; state-certified death investigator [S1][S3]
About 20 years as an anesthesia technician at Harborview and UW Medical Center [S1][S3]
Would modernize investigations, improve accountability and rebuild a team-centered culture [S1]

experience.basis: Deputy coroner of four years challenging the incumbent and campaigning on change.

reform.basis: Promises to improve the office's accountability, rebuild its culture and 'restore confidence in the office'.
